# Agent report — frontend

- **Status:** READY FOR REVIEW
- **Branch / SHA:** agent/frontend (update 2 commit on top of 0f3d6d4; see `git log`)
- **Date (UTC):** 2026-11-11 (update 9: production-bundle guard; merged integration 5238c45)
- **Merged in:** `integration/winterpath` (contract OpenAPI 1.1.0, data-model 1.2.0, platform + data work) via `git merge --no-edit` at ce3013c — no conflicts. Contract **v1.3.0** (503s, `OFF_NETWORK`, canonical source ids) + routing/ML merged at 0f3d6d4 — no conflicts. Contract **v1.4.0/v1.5.0** + routing/data/platform merged after 249570b — no conflicts.

## Files changed (vs merge-base with integration/winterpath)
`123 files changed, 18459 insertions(+)` (all under `apps/web/`, `assets/3d/`, plus this report). `scripts/check-ownership.sh frontend` → `ownership OK for agent/frontend`.

## What was built
- **Stack:** Vite 7 + React 18.3 (per architecture §8) + TS 5.9, Tailwind 4, shadcn-style components (Radix Dialog/Slot + cva, `components.json`), TanStack Query 5, Zustand 5, RHF 7 + Zod 4, i18next 25, Motion 12 (`LazyMotion`), react-router 7 with `/en` `/fr` prefixes.
- **API:** `src/api/schema.d.ts` generated by `openapi-typescript` (`--default-non-nullable=false` so request defaults such as `locale` stay optional) + `openapi-fetch` thin client with typed `ApiRequestError`. No routing or risk logic in the browser.
- **Mocks (`VITE_USE_MOCKS=true`):** MSW handlers for every contract path; payloads validated against `openapi.yaml` with Ajv 2020 in Vitest. Global striped "Demo mode" banner + per-view **Demo data** badge; simulated data shows **SIMULATED/SIMULÉ**. Honesty choices: ECCC alerts list is always empty (no fabricated official alerts); model status `enabled:false, evaluation:null`; data sources never `active`.
- **pilot_mini (per coordinator):** `/map/segments` mock now serves the Data agent's **real** 200-edge OSM fixture (read-only import from `data/fixtures/pilot_mini`, mock build only). Risk is `unknown` with `unknown` evidence on every edge (no risk layer); `step_free` passes through unchanged (2 true / 10 false / 188 null — tested). `/coverage` mock reports the fixture's 88 nodes / 200 edges / OSM snapshot and declares the rest of the pilot area a gap. Hazards, weather and route geometries remain hand-written and `simulated`.
- **Pages:** Landing, Plan, Winter, Reports, How it works, Pilot, hidden Admin (unlinked, `noindex`, token in memory only), 404.
- **Planner:** MapLibre (lazy chunk), map-click origin/destination, consent dialog before geolocation, manual coordinate entry, address search disabled with explanation (no geocoder in contract; no public Nominatim), profile select, avoid-reports toggle, compare card (distance, time, unknown share, evidence-labelled explanations, freshness/stale badges, step list), overlays from `/hazards` + `/map/segments` by debounced (400 ms) pilot-clipped viewport bbox, hatched outside-pilot mask, legend using text + dash patterns + symbols, hazard text list, mobile bottom sheet, NO_ROUTE / OUTSIDE_COVERAGE / RATE_LIMITED copy, re-request on language switch, attribution always expanded and not covered by the sheet (tested).
- **3D hero:** procedural instanced low-poly scene (triplexes, exterior staircases, snowbanks, streetlights, pedestrian, highlighted path, snowfall). SVG poster first; 3D loads after idle only with WebGL, without reduced motion and without Save-Data; `frameloop` drops to `demand` off-screen or when the tab is hidden; DPR ≤ 1.5 desktop / 1 mobile; `aria-hidden` scene + text description + "Illustrative" caption. Measured budget: **9,620 triangles, 17 draw calls** (limit 60k / 50), 0 bytes of GLB/textures.
- **Theme:** tokens from ux-spec; light/dark/system, persisted; contrast unit-tested (teal→frost and slate→#A3B1C4 in dark mode because teal/slate on navy fail 4.5:1).

## Bugs found and fixed along the way
1. MapLibre v6 ESM worker URL broke under Vite → map never fired `load`, so no overlays loaded. Fixed with `setWorkerUrl(…?url)`.
2. `/pilot-requests` 201 with empty body was parsed as JSON and shown as a network error. Fixed with `parseAs: 'text'`.
3. `manualChunks` pulled the 3D vendor chunk into the entry's modulepreload (376 KB gz initial). Removed; initial is now 157 KB gz.
4. Motion's `reducedMotion="user"` still faded opacity. Sections now skip animation entirely under reduced motion (e2e-tested).

## Update 2 — after contract v1.3.0 merge
**Changes**
- `OFF_NETWORK` (422) handled: `ApiRequestError.details` surfaced; `RouteError` names which point is off the network and by how far (also maps the real API's current legacy `OUTSIDE_COVERAGE` + `details.max_snap_distance_m` to the same copy). ## Update 8 — contract v1.7.0, free-tier deployment (Cloudflare Pages): read-only mode, cold start, headers
**Merge:** `git merge --no-edit integration/winterpath` (07a1f29) → `9bd9672`, no conflicts. `npm run gen:api` adds `WRITES_DISABLED` to the `Error.code` union (`schema.d.ts`). Nothing was pushed or deployed, and no external resource was created.

**(1) Read-only demo.** `VITE_PUBLIC_WRITES=false` (`src/lib/env.ts` `PUBLIC_WRITES`) replaces the report and pilot forms with a notice, "Not available in this public demo" / "Non disponible dans cette démo publique" (`src/features/WritesDisabled.tsx`, copy in `common.json`). The same notice replaces a form when the API answers 503 `WRITES_DISABLED`, in builds where writes are on. Reads are unaffected.

**(2) Timeout, cold start and distinct failure states.**
- `src/api/resilientFetch.ts` (used through openapi-fetch's `fetch` option): each attempt has an AbortController timeout (`VITE_API_TIMEOUT_MS`, default 15000).
- Network errors, timeouts and 502/503/504 **without** a WinterPath error body (Render's proxy while the host sleeps) are retried with backoff (1, 2, 4, 8, then every 10 s), within a 90 s budget. Meanwhile a `role="status"` banner says "The server is waking up… about a minute", and the planner says "Waking the server". After the budget, a clear error appears with a retry button.
- A 503 that carries an API code (`UPSTREAM_UNAVAILABLE`, `WRITES_DISABLED`, `INTERNAL`) is a live API and is returned as is.
- Writes that **timed out** are never resent automatically, because the request may still land once the host wakes (no duplicate reports). Writes rejected by the sleeping proxy (502/503 with no body) are retried.
- Caller aborts pass straight through.
- New client codes: `TIMEOUT`, `WAKE_TIMEOUT`, `INCOMPLETE` (a 2xx with an unparsable body, or a compare answer without drawable routes; nothing partial is rendered). EN/FR copy is in `errors.json` and `plan.json`.
- The planner (`RouteError`) has distinct titles for: no route, outside coverage / off network, rate limited, server still asleep, unreachable, data source unavailable (503 `UPSTREAM_UNAVAILABLE`), incomplete answer, and other failures. A retry button appears where a retry can help. "No risk data" (`risk_layer=none`) is unchanged: it is a successful answer with explicit copy.
- Data views (`DataState`) show the code-specific reason plus Retry. Weather 503 now says an external provider is down and shows no values.
- The TanStack Query retry policy no longer stacks on the fetch-layer retries: one extra try, only for a live API's `INTERNAL`/`UNKNOWN` 5xx.

**(3) Cloudflare Pages.**
- `public/_headers` is a template filled at build time by `build/cloudflarePages.ts`:
  - CSP: `default-src 'self'`; `script-src 'self'` plus the sha256 of index.html's inline theme script (no unsafe-inline/eval); `connect-src 'self'`, the API origin from `VITE_API_BASE_URL`, OpenFreeMap and any custom style origin; img `data: blob:` plus map origins; `worker-src 'self' blob:` for MapLibre; `object-src 'none'`; `base-uri 'self'`; `form-action 'self'`; `frame-ancestors 'none'`.
  - Also nosniff, X-Frame-Options DENY, Referrer-Policy strict-origin-when-cross-origin, Permissions-Policy `geolocation=(self)` (camera, microphone, payment, usb and browsing-topics off), COOP same-origin, HSTS, and `/assets/*` `Cache-Control: public, max-age=31536000, immutable`.
- The build fails on any `.map` file or a `404.html`. Non-mock builds drop `mockServiceWorker.js`. `.node-version` = 24.
- `vite preview` serves the generated headers, so **all mock, read-only and real-API e2e now run under the production CSP**.
- zod is set to `jitless`, so its `new Function` probe never triggers a CSP violation.
- `style-src` keeps `'unsafe-inline'`: MapLibre, Motion and React `style` attributes need it.
- Verified production build (`VITE_API_BASE_URL=https://winterpath-api.example.onrender.com/api/v1 VITE_PUBLIC_WRITES=false`, placeholder host): dist = `_headers assets favicon.svg index.html robots.txt`; connect-src = `'self' https://winterpath-api.example.onrender.com https://tiles.openfreemap.org`; the mock-only wake-budget override is not in the bundle.

**(4) Tests.**
- Unit: `resilientFetch.test.ts` (9), `build/cloudflarePages.test.ts` (4), new RouteError cases.
- Mock e2e: `e2e/resilience.spec.ts` covers cold start then recovery; never-ending cold start then bounded give-up, error and working retry (EN planner, FR data view); weather upstream down; compare upstream down then incomplete answer; API `WRITES_DISABLED` on both forms; production headers served, plus zero `securitypolicyviolation` events across landing, planner (MapLibre), the 3D explainer and a zod form. Failures are driven by mock-only localStorage switches in `src/mocks/handlers.ts`.
- `e2e-readonly/` runs with `playwright.readonly.config.ts` (build with `VITE_PUBLIC_WRITES=false`, port 5174) and covers EN/FR notices, no form and no POST, axe on both pages, and the planner still working.

**Accessibility fixes found by these runs (pre-existing, now fixed):**
- The active nav link (`--accent-text` #087f8c) on the ice background was 4.44:1. Light-mode `--accent-text` is now #067380 (≥ 4.76:1 on white, ice and muted); brand fills are unchanged.
- In error alerts, muted grey text on the danger tint was 4.04:1. Error detail text now uses the foreground colour.

**Not verified:** the API has no `API_PUBLIC_WRITES` / `WRITES_DISABLED` implementation on integration yet (`grep -rl WRITES_DISABLED services/` → no match), so that path is tested against mocks only. The cold-start behaviour is tested against simulated proxy responses, not a real sleeping Render instance. The `_headers` file is tested by parsing it and by vite preview, not on Cloudflare itself.

## Update 9 — merge of integration `5238c45`; production-bundle guard (`npm run build:pages`)
**Merge:** `git merge --no-edit integration/winterpath` (5238c45) → `92a88e4`, no conflicts. It brought deployment docs (`docs/SECURITY.md`, `ENVIRONMENT_VARIABLES.md`, `FREE_TIER_LIMITS.md`, `RECOVERY.md`, `DATA_COMPLIANCE.md`) and `.gitignore`. There was no contract, fixture or app change, so `gen:api` was not needed. The docs' description of the frontend (env names, `_headers` contents, waking state, SPA fallback, `.node-version`) matches what update 8 built.

**Gap closed:** `docs/SECURITY.md` says the mock-free production build is "not yet enforced by a CI check". `npm run build:pages` (`build/pagesCheck.ts`, run directly by Node 24) now does two things:
- **Before building**, it refuses `VITE_USE_MOCKS=true`, a `VITE_API_BASE_URL` that isn't absolute https ending in `/api/v1`, `VITE_PUBLIC_WRITES` other than `false` (the read-only decision), a non-numeric timeout, and any `VITE_*` value that looks like a secret.
- **After building**, it scans `dist` for the MSW worker or mock switches (`setupWorker`, `mockServiceWorker`, `wp-mock-`), `.map` files or `sourceMappingURL` comments, a `404.html`, unfilled or test-only `_headers` (needs an https API origin, no `data:` in connect-src, `frame-ancestors 'none'`, nosniff, `geolocation=(self)`, immutable `/assets/*`), and secret-like strings (postgres URL, private key, JWT, `service_role`, `API_ADMIN_TOKEN`, `DATABASE_URL`).

It prints rule ids and file names, never the matched values. A CI job could call it, but CI isn't in my owned paths; this is a suggestion for the platform agent or coordinator.

**Found by the guard:** MapLibre's prebuilt worker kept `//# sourceMappingURL=maplibre-gl-worker.mjs.map` (the map file isn't shipped). The Pages plugin now strips `sourceMappingURL` comments from emitted JS and CSS.

## Update 10 — merge of integration `c9e6c81`; disclose unloaded closure/311 sources; read-only mode verified on the real API
**Merge:** `git merge --no-edit integration/winterpath` fast-forwarded to `c9e6c81` (it already contained `4ed7c81`). No changes to contracts, fixtures or `apps/web`. The new `docs/DEPLOYMENT.md` and `docs/RECOVERY.md` step 5 use `npm run build:pages` as suggested in update 9.

**Honesty gap found from `docs/PRODUCTION_READINESS.md`:** production runs `API_STORE_BACKEND=memory`, so live routes do **not** avoid closures, and `/hazards` returns an empty list. The planner then said "No closures or reports in this view." That presents *not loaded* as *none*, which breaks "unknown is never zero risk". The API already reports the truth: with the memory store, `/data-sources` comes from the static list, where `mtl-entraves` and `mtl-311` are `disabled` (hazards and sources share one backend switch in `state.py`).
- `src/features/plan/hazardCoverage.ts`: computes coverage from `/data-sources` for `mtl-entraves` and `mtl-311`.
  - `complete` only when both are `active`.
  - `partial` lists every other status (a source missing from the list counts as not loaded).
  - `unchecked` while `/data-sources` is loading or has failed.
- `HazardSourceNotice` (Unknown badge, EN/FR) has two forms:
  - **Map layers:** "Closures and 311 reports may be missing from this map … An empty list does not mean there are none."
  - **Compare card:** "These routes could not take closures or 311 reports into account … A route may cross a closure that isn't shown. Check conditions on site."
  - Both name each source with its status (e.g. "Requêtes 311: not loaded").
- `HazardList` says "No closures or reports in this view." only when coverage is `complete`.
- Real-API e2e:
  - asserts the route notice exactly when `/data-sources` shows a hazard source that isn't active;
  - adds an overlay test;
  - adds a read-only test. An empty `POST /reports` probe detects `API_PUBLIC_WRITES=false`: 503 `WRITES_DISABLED` comes before validation, and a write-enabled API answers 422, so nothing is stored. The two write tests skip in that mode.

## Update 11 — WinterPath 2.0 Wave 1 (frontend brief in `docs/agents/v2-plan.md`); merge of integration `eaac440`
**Merge:** `git merge --no-edit integration/winterpath` fast-forwarded to `eaac440` (it contained `bb76eb2`). No contract, fixture or `apps/web` changes. No contract change in this update; only existing v1.7 endpoints are used.

### 1. Map fit after compare (audit problem 8): root cause and fix
The fit-to-route code already existed. Reproduced on the unchanged build (`docs/screenshots/plan-v1-mobile-390-after-compare.png`): on mobile, the sheet jumped to **85 %** after a compare and covered the fitted route. Enlarging the bottom padding alone would not work: when the padding leaves no room, MapLibre silently skips `fitBounds` and leaves the region view.

Fix (`src/features/plan/mapFit.ts`, `PlannerMap.tsx`):
- The map fits the **selected** route.
- The padding reflects what covers the map (the sheet height on mobile) and is clamped so at least 80 px remain (`clampPadding`).
- The map re-fits on a new comparison, a new selection, recenter, a sheet snap and a panel toggle. A `ResizeObserver` keeps the canvas in sync.
- Two bugs found while testing, both fixed:
  - `compare.data?.routes ?? []` produced a new array on every render, which would have restarted the fit endlessly. It is now a stable constant.
  - An interrupted fit animation's `moveend` was being recorded as the new fit.
- Observable through `data-map-ready`, `data-map-fit` and `data-map-zoom` (used by e2e and the perf harness). After: `docs/screenshots/plan-v2-mobile-390-after-compare.png` and `plan-v2-desktop-after-compare.png`.

### 2–3. Mobile bottom sheet and collapsible desktop panel
- **Below `lg`:** full-screen map with a sheet that snaps to peek (76 px handle with a one-line summary of the selected route), half or full.
  - Drag (with flick), tap to cycle, or ArrowUp/ArrowDown on the handle.
  - The handle is ≥ 60 px tall; its accessible name includes the visible summary plus the state.
  - After a compare: half, results scrolled to the top of the sheet, focus on the results heading.
  - "Pick on map" lowers the sheet to peek and brings it back after the pick.
- **Compact route cards** (`RouteCards.tsx`): a tappable `aria-pressed` card per route that selects and highlights the path. Each shows:
  - time and distance;
  - "No condition data for N % of the route" (icon + text);
  - known issues on or avoided by the route;
  - oldest data age with the Stale label.

  The contract has **no route-level risk category**, so none is invented. Full explanations stay below under "Route details".
- **At `lg` and up:** "Hide panel" collapses the left column; "Show planner" brings it back. Focus moves to the button that remains, and the map re-fits.
- **Touch targets:** buttons are ≥ 44 px on coarse pointers (`pointer-coarse:`); desktop density is unchanged.

### 4. Landing page
- Headline "Walk smarter through Montreal's winter." / « Marchez plus malin dans l'hiver montréalais. »; primary action "Plan a walk" / « Planifier une marche ».
- `LandingWeather`: current Montréal observation from the existing `GET /weather/current`.
  - Shows temperature, wind and snow depth, the station and observation time, an evidence badge and freshness/Stale.
  - Missing values show "—". A failure shows a message and **no values**.
  - Fixed min-height, so there is no layout shift.
- The 3D hero is unchanged and still loads after the text and the call to action. The weather block doesn't block entry: the e2e test clicks "Plan a walk" during a weather outage.

### 5–6. Small controls; recent destinations
- **Controls:** swap (existing), **Clear all** (points and results), **Recenter** (route, or pilot area), **Reset layers**. Skeletons, friendly errors and the waking state are unchanged from update 8.
- **Recent destinations** (`stores/recentDestinations.ts`):
  - opt-in checkbox, off by default; nothing is stored before opting in;
  - **destinations only** (never the start point or geolocation), rounded to 4 decimals (≈ 11 m);
  - at most 5, dropped after 30 days, `localStorage` only;
  - "Clear" empties the list, and opting out deletes the list and the flag.

  Architecture §9 says "no persistent location tracking". This is user-chosen, opt-in, device-only data, as the brief asks. Please confirm that the reading is acceptable.

### 7. Performance: before vs after
Method (`apps/web/scripts/perf.mjs`; raw samples in `apps/web/docs/perf/`):
- Playwright Chromium, 390×844 @3x, mobile emulation, **4× CPU slowdown via CDP** (`Emulation.setCPUThrottlingRate`), no network throttling.
- Production build against the local real API (fixture graph, memory store) with the stub basemap style; SwiftShader WebGL.
- A fresh context per run, one discarded warm-up, then **9 runs**; medians with min–max.
- The machine was shared with other agents (1-min load average 22 → 15 during "before", 11.7 → 14.4 during "after", on 10 CPUs). Treat differences under about 20 % as noise.

| Metric (390 px, 4× CPU) | Before `eaac440` median (min–max) | After median (min–max) |
|---|---|---|
| Landing LCP (`h1`) | 1016 ms (732–1780) | 828 ms (780–1144) |
| Landing TBT | 284 ms (156–561) | 195 ms (128–257) |
| Planner LCP | 732 ms (628–1236) | 612 ms (556–784) |
| Planner usable (Compare enabled) | 663 ms (571–960) | 578 ms (530–638) |
| Planner TBT (incl. MapLibre parse) | 1098 ms (768–4006) | 1206 ms (866–1298) |
| Map ready | 1368 ms (1244–2567) | 1333 ms (1268–1392) |
| Compare click → route cards | 856 ms (478–1391) | 451 ms (304–1213) |
| Compare click → map fitted on route | not observable (no fit signal; mobile route hidden by the sheet) | 1129 ms (876–1846), zoom 17 in 9/9 |

Reading:
- LCP is well under 2.5 s in both builds **under these conditions** (no network throttling). This is not the earlier Lighthouse figure of about 3 s, which used simulated slow-4G. The two methods are not comparable.
- I'm claiming no LCP improvement: the medians moved within the noise band.
- Planner TBT stays about 1.1–1.2 s: MapLibre parsing and initialisation (298 kB gz chunk) on a slowed CPU. Reducing it needs a different map-loading strategy; not done in this wave.
- Initial JS 149.2 KB gz (was 147.6; budget 250).

## Not done / not measured (stated plainly)
- Real-API e2e used a local API with the fixture graph and memory store (risk provider none, and the ML heuristic layer in updates 4 and 6). Not tested against Postgres/PostGIS.
- **LCP < 2.5 s not met** in local Lighthouse mobile runs (see Update 2). CLS and a11y targets met there. No field data.
- **Screenshots + a visual pass done (update 5); no manual screen-reader QA.** Axe passing ≠ WCAG conformance; I'm not claiming compliance.
- 3D frame rate (60 fps target) not measured on real hardware; e2e uses SwiftShader.
- Condition explainer built (update 6); its frame rate is not measured either (it renders on demand only).
- Intermittent axe `color-contrast` result in e2e (1 of 21 mock runs on `/pilot`; real-API `/` before the settle-wait fix). Root cause not proven.
- `npm audit`: 7 moderate findings remain, all the same `minimatch` ReDoS in dev-only lint tooling (`typescript-eslint`). Critical `maplibre-gl` ≤6.4 and high `zod` <4.6.6 advisories were avoided by using maplibre-gl 6.17.0 / zod 4.6.7; vitest 4.1.12 avoids the critical tinypool/vitest advisories.
